notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41519313/663d9bef07294dc8d0327b44bc497f4059c6d28f.png[/img]

Hi, everyone! 🙌 
We are happy to announce that our game Soulflow is part of Steam Mystery Fest! 🥳

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1822900/Soulflow/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

Soulflow is a 2.5D fantasy-detective game that offers a unique experience with its graphic style. In this story-based role play game, the player must gather information from others during the day and try to solve the murders in the neighborhood to stay free.👻

Hope that you can try our game and give us your feedback! 🤓

notes.title: Soulflow is released in early access on Steam! 🥳
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41519313/b9b584377a36dc7613297433f7375f2bf2bfac9a.png[/img]

Hi, everyone! 🙌 
We are happy to announce that our game Soulflow is in early access on Steam! 🥳

Soulflow is a 2.5D fantasy-detective game that offers a unique experience with its graphic style. In this story-based role play game, the player must gather information from others during the day and try to solve the murders in the neighborhood to stay free.👻  

❗️ Don't forget to give us feedback about Soulflow on our Steam page or Discord!
❗️ Next in Game Official DC: [url=https://discord.gg/TGzUUpyKNS]Join our Discord![/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1822900/Soulflow/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

For the soul to be free, the body must die. In other words, players have to figure out who is going to die. It does this by "saluting", that is, by changing the body. When the actor who plays the soul greets another character, he takes control of that character and begins to see the world through his eyes. In this way, he can carry out dialogues with different combinations with different people.

That’s enough for today’s blog, we would like to see all of you on our page. 
We can’t wait to bring the full version. 🚀

Hope that you can try our game and give us your feedback! 🤓

notes.title: Soulflow Demo is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41519313/7e7d3ecb884dfb5d1c522a19645a370b0d4d1675.png[/img]

We are excited to write down our first blog. We have been working on our game for a while and it will be available for you to try on Steam Next Fest 21 February 2022 in Early Access.

You’ll also be able to join the developer stream on February 25th, 2022, PST at 01:00 PM here. We are humbled by your continuous support from day one.

If you haven’t already heard of it, Soulflow is a 2.5D fantasy-detective game that offers a unique experience with its graphic style. In this story-based role play game, the player must gather information from others during the day and try to solve the murders in the neighborhood to stay free.

For the soul to be free, the body must die. In other words, players have to figure out who is going to die. It does this by "saluting", that is, by changing the body. When the actor who 
plays the soul greets another character, he takes control of that character and begins to see the world through his eyes. In this way, he can carry out dialogues with different combinations with different people. Thus, new information is obtained through the story and the game is shaped. "Finding the character to die", which is the prerequisite for our freedom, is achieved with the information we have gained in the story. Of course, the story does not progress with dialogue alone. We can get information about the items and characters in different houses.

That’s enough for today’s blog, we would like to see all of you on Steam Next Fest. We can’t wait to bring the full version.

Our Discord server is ready here for you to jump in if you would like to reach us directly.

[url=https://discord.gg/TGzUUpyKNS][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41519313/fcf474262240c9eaa6fa41454946f9341ea19e1e.png[/img][/url][url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41519224][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41519313/af6324e0d6200e3888c1a58847a16ad4dff2a23e.jpg[/img][/url]


Don’t forget to add to your wishlist, stay tuned!
